name: Pop-Kultur Festival
description: Pop-Kultur is an interdisciplinary festival bringing together live music, lectures, exhibitions and discussions. With its zeitgeist-driven programming combining concerts, talks, performances and art formats, the festival offers a unique platform where visitors can drift through evenings at their own pace or cherry-pick exactly what interests them. The festival showcases the biggest and most creative names across fields, providing insight into what goes on behind the scenes of contemporary culture.
